text: Gio Bernard breaks free and runs 89 yards. Bengals 14–7.
Then Andy Dalton starts throwing the game away.
Carolina pounces. Cam Newton powers in. Panthers 24–17.
Fourth quarter. Dalton goes deep to Sanu. 24–24. Now it's war.
Panthers go up 31–24. Pacman Jones answers...
...97 yards. Bengals tie it, 31–31. Back from the dead.
Nugent kicks Cincinnati ahead, 34–31. Surely that's the end.
Five seconds left. Gano from 44 ties it. 34–34. Neither team will die.
Overtime. A field goal each. 37–37. Still nobody falls.
Two seconds. Nugent from 36, to end it...
Wide right. Seventy-five minutes, and nobody survives.
